# Widian Website Content & Claims

- Use British English.
- Product claims must be supportable from authoritative application evidence and recorded/reviewed through `docs/CLAIMS_REGISTER.md`.
- Distinguish current capability, qualified capability and future/vision.
- Contractor completion is not verified closure.
- Circular Compliance is a strategic lifecycle, not a legal compliance status.
- Do not invent customers, testimonials, awards, statistics, certifications, penetration tests or ROI.
- Preserve the message hierarchy: Building Record → verified closure → Circular Compliance.
- Avoid generic SaaS filler and fear-based compliance copy.
